description: Govbase provides U.S. federal policy data — search bills, executive orders, look up Congress members and voting records, browse narrative story bundles, and get civic info like representatives and polling locations by address.

rawRecord.description: Govbase provides U.S. federal policy data — search bills, executive orders, look up Congress members and voting records, browse narrative story bundles, and get civic info like representatives and polling locations by address.

detail.description: Govbase provides U.S. federal policy data — search bills, executive orders, look up Congress members and voting records, browse narrative story bundles, and get civic info like representatives and polling locations by address.

tools.name: search_policies
tools.description: Search U.S. federal policies and legislation by keyword, topic, or bill name. Returns a list of matching policies with summaries.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific U.S. federal policy by its ID (e.g., "bill-119-hr-22" or "eo-2025-1234").

tools.name: get_policy_text
tools.description: Retrieve the full text of a U.S. federal policy document. Returns the raw legislative or regulatory text.

tools.name: search_members
tools.description: Search current U.S. members of Congress by name, state, party, or chamber. Returns a list of matching members with key details.

tools.name: get_member
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific U.S. member of Congress by their Bioguide ID (e.g., "P000197" for Nancy Pelosi).

tools.name: get_member_vote
tools.description: Check how a specific U.S. member of Congress voted on a policy by providing their Bioguide ID and the policy ID. Returns all roll call votes for that member on the given policy.

policy_id.description: Policy ID to check vote on

tools.name: get_stories
tools.description: List current story bundles tracking ongoing policy issues. Returns a feed of active stories grouping related policies and developments.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific story bundle by its ID, including the full timeline of related events.

tools.name: get_representatives
tools.description: Look up elected representatives for a given U.S. address, including federal, state, and local officials.

address.description: Street address (e.g., "1600 Pennsylvania Ave, Washington DC")

tools.name: get_voter_info
tools.description: Get election and polling location information for a registered U.S. voter address, including upcoming elections and early vote sites.
